selectedFunctions.label: Midas mTBILL depositInstant custom recipient
warnings: mTBILL is a tokenized investment product, not an insured bank deposit or a risk-free USDC vault. Issuer, legal/enforceability, custody/counterparty, underlying investment, oracle, upgrade/admin, stablecoin and liquidity risks remain; catalog admission is not an investment-safety determination.

Only eligible users and recipients may transact. Applicable legal terms, jurisdiction restrictions and onboarding/KYC must be independently satisfied. Onchain source enforces conditional greenlisting, blacklisting and configured Chainalysis sanctions checks for sender and custom recipient; no eligibility bypass is admitted or implied. Official eligibility webpage returned HTTP403 during review, so no claim is made that its full current terms were read.

All vault amountToken, amountMTokenIn and minReceiveAmount parameters use base-18 normalized units, including payment tokens such as six-decimal USDC. They are NOT raw USDC units. The implementation converts to the actual token precision and rejects nonrepresentable rounding; token and mTBILL conversion rates are not necessarily 1:1.

Use only currently configured payment tokens after reviewing getPaymentTokens/tokensConfig and token-specific feeds. No arbitrary-token executor or unbound route is admitted. Global and per-selector pauses, token allowance budgets, minimums, data-feed checks, fees and instant daily limits apply; mTBILL issuance also has a supply cap and first-deposit minimum.

Instant deposit transfers caller payment tokens to the configured proceeds/fee recipients then mints mTBILL. Instant redemption directly burns the caller net mTBILL using the vault burner role, transfers any fee using caller allowance, and pays from vault liquidity. User allowance must cover all payment-token transfers and any mTBILL fee transfer; request redemption needs allowance for the full mTBILL transfer.

Request operations are asynchronous and administrator-settled, not instant exits and not a user-claim/epoch mechanism. DepositRequest immediately sends payment tokens away; redeemRequest escrows net mTBILL and transfers fees. A vault admin later approves at a chosen rate (safe variants check tolerance), mints to the recorded recipient or burns escrow and pays from requestRedeemer. There is no ordinary user approve/claim/cancel/refund capability in these ABIs, no fixed fulfillment epoch or bounded waiting time.

rejectRequest is admin-only and merely marks a request canceled in the reviewed implementation; it does not automatically refund payment tokens, escrowed mTBILL or fees. Custom recipient overloads store the beneficiary as request.sender; carefully distinguish funding caller from recipient. Request rate changes, admin rejection, offchain processing and requestRedeemer liquidity/allowance may delay or prevent settlement.

No fresh RPC implementation identity, eligible wallet status, enabled tokens, fees/caps/pauses, balances, liquidity, successful execution or fulfillment timing was verified. Static deployment/ABI evidence grants no signing permission or independent execution-control bypass.
